MauBank TT Payment Instruction

Turn a client's payment instruction from the ACBM platform into a completed MauBank Form 057 (Telegraphic Transfer application), ready for signature.

1 · Client's payment instruction
Drop, choose or paste (Ctrl/Cmd+V) a screenshotClaude reads the fields from the image — check every value before generating.

Fill in the form below directly.

2 · Debit account (client's linked account)
…or drop, choose or paste a screenshotof the Linked account panel
3 · Check the form
Application
1. Remitter details
2. Details of payment
3. Transfer instruction
4–5. Purpose & charges
6. Customer authorisation — signatories

Mapping: remitter = the client (sender organisation); amount = the beneficiary amount — for currency conversions, the target amount in the target currency; charges box follows "Charges paid by". An IBAN is only printed if it passes the IBAN checksum. The two selected signatories are printed under the Applicant's Signature(s) box, with space above each name to sign. Nothing is uploaded unless you use the screenshot reader, which sends the image to Claude.
